stations.title: Effie
stations.say: Same boxes, so why is it red?

stations.title: Lorcan's tests
stations.text: They watch the helpers, not the box.

stations.title: Wendell
stations.text: Packs from the list, whoever wrote the code.

captions: Effie tidied the packing code, every box came out the same, and a test still went red.
Lorcan's tests watch which helpers the code calls, so they miss what goes in the box.
You test the packing list itself: the order things go in, the crate and the weight.
Now a rewrite that packs the same stays green, and a real mistake turns a test red.
Same boxes for Wendell. Effie can tidy the code without fear of the tests.
